234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

256742|424df33e.name: Dianne Softstep
256742|424df33e.text:
Ah, I am afraid you and I have no business at this time.

If you end up fulfilling some contracts with the trade authority then perhaps we will have something to discuss later.

342|b06a17dd.name: Martie Jainrose
342|b06a17dd.text: Hail, HARUNO!  Welcome to my humble garden.  The weather has been perfect lately.  Let us hope it holds steady for a ripe harvest.

6300|0b719f6c.name: Elisa Steelhand
6300|0b719f6c.text: How can I help you, friend?

116-progress.name: Barkeep Daniels
116-progress.text: I need you to pick up a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the Westfall hills, a cask of Merlot from Stormwind, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire and a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire.  Bring those back to me and I will see to it you are rewarded.
116-progress.title: Dry Times

117-progress.name: Grimbooze Thunderbrew
117-progress.text:
Hurry, my friend, move with haste 
In order for our rich lager to taste
More like beer and less like stew,
Hops are needed to make the brew.
117-progress.title: Thunderbrew

118-progress.name: Smith Argus
118-progress.text: What's that?  Verner sent you, you say?  Well give me his note.  And SPEAK UP!
118-progress.title: The Price of Shoes

119-progress.name: Verner Osgood
119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?
119-progress.title: Return to Verner

121-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
121-progress.text: Did the General send news?  Are reinforcements on the way?
121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

129-progress.name: Guard Parker
129-progress.text: Darcy sent me a lunch, did she?  Such a kind heart she has.  Well...let's have it!
129-progress.title: A Free Lunch

131-progress.name: Darcy
131-progress.text: Hello again, $N.  Did Parker like the lunch I sent him?
131-progress.title: Delivering Daffodils

132-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
132-progress.text: Good to see you back, $N.  What did Wiley have to say for himself?
132-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

135-progress.name: Master Mathias Shaw
135-progress.text: What business do you have with me?  I am a very busy man. . .
135-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

141-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?
141-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

142-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

143-progress.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
143-progress.text: Hail, $c.  What business do you have with The People's Militia?
143-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

144-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
144-progress.text: Shall we expect the People's Militia soon?  Does Lord Stoutmantle's news bode well?
144-progress.title: Messenger to Westfall

145-progress.name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
145-progress.text: You appear to have traveled from afar, $C.  What business do you have here in Darkshire?
145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

146-progress.name: Magistrate Solomon
146-progress.text: Ah, good to see you back, messenger.  Shall I inform the Marshal that the Night Watch is on its way from Darkshire?
146-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

153-progress.name: Scout Galiaan
153-progress.text: Bring me 15 red leather bandanas and I'll pay you well.
153-progress.title: Red Leather Bandanas

332-progress.name: Suzetta Gallina
332-progress.text: Greetings and welcome, master.  Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
332-progress.title: Wine Shop Advert

95999-accept.name: Unknown
95999-accept.text:
Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep.

Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will to be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
95999-accept.title: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im

96394-accept.name: Afadra Dunwall
96394-accept.text:
Something has disturbed the tombs down in the Hall of Thanes, and strange noises have been heard coming from deep within the vaults. The spirits of the dead are light sleepers, and whatever is going on down there seems to have startled them.

Head down there and see what you can do about that for us. If any of the dead are awake--well, put them back down!
96394-accept.title: The Restless Dead

96395-accept.name: Unknown
96395-accept.text:
The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest.

Please... help him... help him... rest...

Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
96395-accept.title: An Ancient Grudge

96395-complete.name: Unknown
96395-complete.text:
My... Thane... he... rests... yes... rest.

Thank... you...

I... rest...
96395-complete.title: An Ancient Grudge

96403-accept.name: Thom Filch
96403-accept.text:
You there, adventurer... I could really use your aid.

I was sneaking--uh... 'patrolling' in the vaults when a force of Dark Iron dwarves emerged from the depths in mole machines! I don't know what they are here for, but there is priceless loot--uh or, rather... I mean, 'important cultural heirlooms' down there! Please, recover any such relics you see and return them here.

I assure you that anything you recover will be catalogued and returned to its proper place of honor.
96403-accept.title: Important Heirlooms

98407-accept.name: Deputy Feldon
98407-accept.text:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.

The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.

Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
98407-accept.title: Show of Force
